teaser: The wheel spins under your hand, still carrying a wobble from the last ride, and you stop it with two fingers before it finishes its turn. That instinct — catch the problem before it becomes a crash — sits close to what life path 1 and the ISTJ temperament share. The 1 asks for a life built on your own authority, standing apart to lead; the ISTJ holds steady under weight, measuring twice before cutting once. Crossed, the two don't just agree to go first and go carefully — they insist on it, in the same hand, at the same time. You don't experiment here. You correct.
